To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) We searched for new physics phenomena in events with jets (J), two same sign or three charged leptons (L) using 137 fb-1 of data at 13 TeV, 2) No evidence for new physics was observed, 3) We set limits on gluino and squark pair production for various decay modes in the context of SUSY models, 4) We set model independent limits for a variety of simplified signal models.
we observed no evidence of new physics in the data and set the most stringent limits on gluino and squark production to date, with a few examples of the most relevant limits shown in Figure 1.
the observed results are consistent with the standard model and the limits on the gluino and squark masses are as high as 2.2 TeV for gluino-pair production and 0.8 TeV for squark-pair production.
